scenarios.reason: Final verification failed: "The tooltip says "Unfold this section" and the only paragraph readable on screen in the editor says "Visible body"."
scenarios.diagnosis: The editor does not keep the folded state of the first section when the user leaves the file tab and returns to it.
scenarios.suggestion: Preserve each document's folded-section state when its tab is deactivated and restore that state when the tab is selected again. Add a regression test that folds a section, changes tabs, returns, and verifies that only "Visible body" is shown and the chevron tooltip says "Unfold this section".
